blocks.html: RLC Residences’ kicks-off the first quarter of 2021 with two construction milestones for two of its fast-selling projects in Pasig City--Cirrus and the S Tower of SYNC. Cirrus, a project catering to highly driven urban professionals offers smartly-sized studio units ideal for fast-paced city living. SYNC, on the other hand, presents a dynamic lifestyle envisioned for start-up couples or yuppies pursuing multi-faceted passions.

Present in the concrete pouring ceremonies were RLC Residences key executives, Vice President for Construction and Design Engr. Emmanuel Arce, Project Director Arch. Juan R. Herrera, Jr., Sales Head Mr. Ferdinand C. Adriano, Business Development Head Ms. Maria Theresa P. Mag-Isa, and Marketing Head Ms. Karen D. Cesario.

These high-rise condominiums have been impressing property investors based both in the Philippines and abroad for its incredible locations, generous unit offerings, structural design, and a superb selection of recreational facilities.
For more information about Cirrus and SYNC, visit www.rlcresidences.com or like and follow us @RLCResidencesPH on Facebook and @rlc_residences on Instagram.
